mapper.sql:
left join ( select dedup_archive.P_Id as project_id, sfa2.File_MD5_Code as file_md5, max(
) as max_key from Archive_File af2 left join Archive dedup_archive on dedup_archive.Ap_Id = af2.Ap_Id left join SYS_FileAnnex sfa2 on sfa2.file_id = af2.Af_Annex_Id where sfa2.File_MD5_Code is not null group by dedup_archive.P_Id, sfa2.File_MD5_Code ) latest_md5 on sfa.File_MD5_Code = latest_md5.file_md5 and (${archiveAlias}.P_Id = latest_md5.project_id or (${archiveAlias}.P_Id is null and latest_md5.project_id is null)) and = latest_md5.max_key
mapper.select:

#{item}

sql.if: and (ad.Ad_Id = #{params.adId} or ad.Ad_Link like concat((select Ad_Link from Archive_Directory where Ad_Id = #{params.adId}), '/%'))
and (pro.P_Use_Unit like concat('%',#{params.pUseUnit},'%') or c11.C_Name like concat('%',#{params.pUseUnit},'%'))

mapper.sql: and (sfa.File_MD5_Code is null or latest_md5.max_key is not null)

from
